name: GROUNDREADS-route-reports
old: : known || groundMarkDone(db, rows[0]?.[0]) ? keptFacts(keys, rows[off] ?? [], rows[off + 1] ?? [])

name: GROUNDREADS-route-mid-fill
old: : await factsOf(db, keys, 'pixel');   // the fill still running: the reports, as before it

name: GROUNDREADS-route-mark-unread
old: const pixelReads = !keys.length ? [] : [...(known ? [] : [fillMarkStatement(db)]), confirmedStatement(db, keys), reportedStatement(db, keys)];
new: const pixelReads = !keys.length ? [] : [...(known ? [] : [confirmedStatement(db, keys)]), confirmedStatement(db, keys), reportedStatement(db, keys)];

name: GROUNDREADS-unconfirmed-none

name: GROUNDREADS-harvest-reports

name: GROUNDREADS-harvest-mid-fill
